title: How banking knowledge becomes usable
purpose: One reusable explanatory model for the CLM AI Knowledge Hub. This is authored conceptual architecture, not an inventory of deployed SEB systems.
primary_question: What allows different forms of CLM work to apply the same institutional meaning without assuming shared permissions or approvals?

nodes.label: Business work
nodes.question: What work becomes better?
nodes.description: The CLM task, decision or process sets the outcome that any AI assistance must serve.
nodes.reuse: Work patterns and acceptance questions can be shared; responsibility for execution stays within the actual process.
nodes.boundary: A capability without a useful business task is not an outcome.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: Illustrative requirement and prepared observation; neither is an executed business outcome.

nodes.label: Applicable authority
nodes.question: Which instructions actually apply?
nodes.description: Relevant regulatory sources, approved internal interpretation, policy and instructions each have different authority and effective scope.
nodes.reuse: Versioned source references and approved, scoped interpretations may inform several tasks.
nodes.boundary: A draft, a legal citation and an approved bank rule are not interchangeable.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: A synthetic instruction and its unapproved revision candidate; not bank-approved policy.

nodes.label: Domain meaning
nodes.question: What does the bank mean?
nodes.description: Owned vocabulary, definitions, relationships and field meanings distinguish customer, party, role, control, evidence and obligation across contexts.
nodes.reuse: One governed definition can inform requirements, explanations, software and AI without being independently reinvented.
nodes.boundary: A data catalogue entry or field name does not by itself establish business meaning.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: Reported field meaning and an illustrative mapping; current source data and approved aliases are not established.

nodes.label: Evidence & data
nodes.question: What case evidence is available?
nodes.description: System records, documents, events and observed facts provide context only with source, subject, time and permission boundaries.
nodes.reuse: Data contracts, schemas and lineage patterns can be reused; customer-specific access cannot be assumed.
nodes.boundary: Missing evidence must stay unknown. A system value is not automatically an approved interpretation.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: A source-linked draft and a proposed data product; neither demonstrates authorised live customer retrieval.

nodes.label: AI capability
nodes.question: What may the capability do?
nodes.description: A bounded AI task uses a defined method and permitted knowledge, data and tools to help prepare, compare or analyze work.
nodes.reuse: Methods, tested skills, tool contracts and evaluations may serve multiple tasks when scoped and reviewed.
nodes.boundary: A model, UI, agent or prompt does not grant execution authority.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: A bounded method specimen; the document does not prove an installed, executable AI skill.

nodes.label: Controls & access
nodes.question: Which boundaries prevent a wrong action?
nodes.description: Permissions, ownership, explicit operating constraints and human supervision limit what tools can access and do.
nodes.reuse: Control patterns are reusable only when a named owner accepts their scope and tests their effect.
nodes.boundary: Governance shown in a diagram is not evidence that a control exists or works.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: A proposed adverse test and reuse review; no working enforcement or approval is claimed.

nodes.label: Human judgement
nodes.question: Who decides?
nodes.description: A responsible human reviews consequential outputs and performs or authorizes the decision within the applicable business process.
nodes.reuse: Review criteria and decision evidence can improve shared methods; accountability is not delegated to a model.
nodes.boundary: AI-generated proposals are not approvals, nor verified customer or regulatory outcomes.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: A review candidate with owner unassigned; no completed human decision is claimed.

nodes.label: Evidence of work
nodes.question: What shows what happened?
nodes.description: Execution logs, evaluated outputs, observed tests, human review and incidents make performance and failure visible over time.
nodes.reuse: Real evaluation signals can motivate controlled knowledge changes and reusable test cases.
nodes.boundary: Proposed tests and illustrative traces are not observed operating evidence.
nodes.hub_crosswalk_note: An unexecuted test case and empty evidence record; there is no observed test result.

edges.condition: The task defines what assistance should achieve.
edges.claim: Business work informs bounded AI purpose.

edges.condition: Relevant source and approved interpretation must be established for the task.
Definitions and mappings have sufficient scope, provenance and status.
edges.claim: Governed domain meaning informs AI reasoning.

edges.condition: The concept applies to the work being performed.
edges.claim: Shared terminology improves human work too.

edges.condition: Access, purpose, party identity, source and freshness have been checked.
edges.claim: Case evidence informs AI within permitted boundaries.

edges.condition: Controls are configured, enforced and evaluated—not merely described.
edges.claim: Execution is governed by permissions and controls.

edges.condition: The human can inspect source, uncertainty and output status.
edges.claim: AI proposals inform, but do not constitute, decisions.

edges.condition: An actual run took place and logging/evaluation is enabled.
The accountable action and rationale were actually recorded.
edges.claim: Human review can produce decision evidence.

edges.condition: A domain steward reviews evidence and authorizes any change.
edges.claim: Observed defects may inform a governed concept revision.

perspectives.label: Reusable knowledge
perspectives.question: Why shouldn't every assistant rebuild its own banking understanding?
perspectives.answer: Shared concepts can inform many tasks, while every use still has its own scope, permission and validation.
perspectives.footnote: One meaning; different work. No automatic permission transfer.

perspectives.label: Bounded AI assistance
perspectives.question: What makes an AI task useful without giving it unchecked authority?
perspectives.answer: The task determines the outcome, relevant meaning and case evidence provide context, controls constrain action, and a human remains accountable.
perspectives.footnote: The capability is neither the source of truth nor the decision maker.

perspectives.label: Change and learning
perspectives.question: What happens when an instruction or interpretation changes?
perspectives.answer: Its affected meanings, task methods and tests need review. Evaluation can reveal gaps, but cannot approve its own semantic or policy changes.
perspectives.footnote: Impact review is not automatic policy supersession or live implementation.

knowledge_forms.label: Language
knowledge_forms.question: Which terms are shared?
knowledge_forms.description: Stable labels, aliases and controlled vocabulary.

knowledge_forms.label: Meaning
knowledge_forms.question: How do concepts relate?
knowledge_forms.description: Business definitions, relations, subject and scope.

knowledge_forms.label: Rules
knowledge_forms.question: What conditions apply?
knowledge_forms.description: Explicit applicability, exceptions and decision logic.

meaning_layers.label: Metadata
meaning_layers.description: What sources, tables, fields and records exist.

meaning_layers.label: Business semantics
meaning_layers.description: What the bank means, with an accountable interpretation.

meaning_layers.label: Concept relationships
meaning_layers.description: Which parties, roles, events and obligations relate—and how.

meaning_layers.label: System mappings
meaning_layers.description: How governed concepts correspond to fields and interfaces, with version and caveats.

invariants: Metadata documents data, but does not independently establish approved business meaning.
Shared domain semantics do not grant permission to retrieve or change customer data.
A new source or proposed rule does not automatically supersede an approved instruction.
Unknown case evidence is unknown, not a negative fact or an inferred value.
AI output does not constitute a human decision.
An evaluation result can trigger human review but cannot approve its own knowledge changes.
lineage: Conceptual synthesis based on supplied Knowledge-as-Code and CLM Hub material; working explanation, not a verified production architecture. The Hub crosswalk points only to existing authored objects; all source and status qualifiers belong to those objects.
